title: IROTE: Human-Like Traits Elicitation of Large Language Model via In-Context Self-Reflective Optimization
reasoning: The paper evaluates LLM behavior using established value systems, specifically Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) and the Schwartz Theory of Basic Human Values. It assesses dimensions such as 'Sanctity', 'Tradition', 'Fairness', and 'Care', and benchmarks the model's performance on the MoralPrompt dataset.
